postSubject: So, we took our chocolate iced coffee and gave it a new name.I got permission from my boss, (who is a huge fnaf fan) to call it ''Scott's Special'' or the ''Scott Cawthon special''.Believe it or not, we sold a lot by that name.He said by next Friday we have to change it back to ''chocolate twisted iced coffee'' though.EDIT: Just to clarify, this is only for the Sonic in Bardstown, Ky.It took an hour and a half of reasoning with the big boss, (who owns the store I work at plus 7 others) to allow this.The only reason he did was because his 14 year old daughter and 9 year old son plays fnaf.And he enjoys the games too.Note that this isONLYuntil next friday, so I did all I could.We sold a lot by that name once we told people about it Tbh.
commentSubject: That's definitely awesome. I wished I lived closer so I could enjoy one! But seriously, it's an honor! Thank you!
